subject: AstraWell tenant kickoff — workspace seed & API access plan
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Sanchez <sofia@astrawell.health>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: AstraWell tenant kickoff — workspace seed & API access plan

Hi Sofia —

Thanks for confirming the start date. Per our onboarding checklist, attached is a proposed seed plan for the tenant: projects, initial admin roles, and the API key seeding cadence. Key asks from our side for Monday's kickoff:

- Confirm the three admin contacts who will receive org-admin invites (we'll send invites from the private console).
- Confirm whether you want API keys rotated by project or a single service key for initial testing.
- Any compliance notes about admin naming conventions or required SSO attributes.

We propose the following immediate deliverables this week (see AstraWell-seed-plan-v1.xlsx):
1) Create two projects: dev-integration, prod-sandbox
2) Seed one service API key scoped to dev-integration (expires in 90 days), and create per-user keys for the three admins
3) Add RBAC groups: infra-admins, app-developers, analytics-readonly

Monica will own the invite sequence and Dev will seed keys and check the KV store encryption policy. Ben will do a quick latency smoke test once the dev key is active.

Can you confirm the admin list and whether Kunal should be included on the invite? If you prefer, we can template the invite message so it goes straight to the named admins.

Thanks,

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
Sr. Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Marissa —

Appreciate the clear plan. Quick answers:
- Admins: Kunal Rao, Priya Desai (priya.desai@astrawell.health), and Omar Martinez (omar.martinez@astrawell.health). Please include Kunal on the inviter list.
- We prefer one service key for initial integration (dev-only), but will move to per-project keys after successful testing.
- SSO: we require fullName and employeeID attributes on the SAML assertion for admin accounts.

We'll get back shortly if the security team requests any additional constraints — they are usually quick. I attached our internal network policy excerpt for context (not included here).

Sofia

KMS alias: projects/astrawell/kms-redwood-001 (I'll hand off the alias to AstraWell IT in a secure note after they confirm). 2) Create RBAC groups and seed three admin user entries (Kunal, Priya, Omar) as org-admins with MFA requirement flagged
3) Create single service API key for dev-integration, store in KMS alias, and rotate to per-project keys on successful smoke test

I'll upload the runbook to the shared board and post the link here once live.
